title: Stepwise Shock Wave Lithotripsy in Pediatric Urolithiasis
brief_summary: To evaluate and compare the results of conventional and stepwise shock wave lithotripsy treatment modalities in pediatric urinary lithiasis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

The patients with pediatric urinary lithiasis.

Exclusion Criteria:

Resistant urinary tract infections Coagulopathies Anatomically obstructed urinary system
